harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The clause «ولقد بعثنا» is resumptive; «أن» is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause «اعبدوا» is explicative, because the sending mentioned before it implies the sense of saying. The clause «فمنهم من هدى الله» is conjoined to the clause «بعثنا», with no grammatical position. «مَنْ»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «فسيروا» is resumptive. His words «كيف»: an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of the abrogating «كان», and «عاقبة» is its noun; the clause is the object of the looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative and carries the sense of knowing.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: His words «وما لهم من ناصرين»: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is negating; the preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida); and «ناصرين» is the mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «وما لهم من ناصرين» is conjoined to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: «جهد»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq). The clause «لا يبعث الله» is the apodosis of the oath; it is not emphasised with the nūn because it is negated. His words «بلى»: a particle of answer. «وعدا»: mafʿūl muṭlaq of an implied governor, i.e.: وعد ذلك وعدا; the preposition «عليه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «وعدا»; and «حقا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted governor, i.e.: حقَّ ذلك حقا. The two clauses «وعد وعدا» and «وحق حقا» are parenthetical between the two conjoined elements. The clause «ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون» is conjoined to an implied clause, i.e.: بلى يبعثهم ولكن أكثر ...

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليبيِّن» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied «يبعثهم»; and the interpreted maṣdar «أنهم كانوا» stands in place of the two objects of «علم».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: «إنما»: the restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). The preposition «لشيء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «قولنا»; «إذا» is a pure adverb attached to a ḥāl of «قولنا»; the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن نقول له» is the khabar (predicate) of «قولنا». His words «كن»: a complete imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) the pronoun "you" (أنت). The fāʾ in «فيكون» is resumptive, and «يكون» is a complete imperfect verb whose fāʿil is the pronoun "he" (هو); the clause «يكون» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being هو, i.e.: فهو يكون. The clause «فهو يكون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: (والذين هاجروا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause of the relative noun is resumptive; the two prepositional phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi. His words «حسنة»: a second object, on the basis that the verb is made to contain the sense of نعطيهم (we give them). The clause «لنبوئنَّهم» is the apodosis of the oath, and the oath with its apodosis is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين». The clause «ولأجر الآخرة أكبر» is resumptive, and the clause «لو كانوا يعلمون» is resumptive; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e.: لآمنوا (they would have believed).

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: (الذين صبروا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The relative noun is a badal (substitute) of the preceding relative noun, and the clause «يتوكلون» is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause).

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «وما أرسلنا» is resumptive; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the clause «نوحي» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رجالا»; the clause «فاسألوا» is resumptive; and the clause «إن كنتم لا تعلمون» is resumptive, its apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) being omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The preposition «بالبينات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {تَعْلَمُونَ} in the preceding verse. The clause «أنزلنا» is resumptive. The clause «ولعلهم يتفكرون» is conjoined to the purpose expressed earlier, as a case of conjoining a clause to a single word, i.e.: للتبيين ولعلهم يتفكرون.

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «أفَأَمِنَ» is resumptive. «السيئات» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «مكروا», on the basis that مكروا is made to contain the sense of فَعَلوا (they did). The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the object of «أمن», and the clause «لا يشعرون» is muḍāf ilayhi.

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The preposition «في تقلبهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object, i.e.: ملتبسين في تقلبهم (while engaged in their going about). The clause «فما هم بمعجزين» is conjoined to the clause «يأخذهم», and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) of «ما», which operates like ليس.

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The preposition «على تخوف» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ, and the clause «فإن ربكم لرءوف» is conjoined to the clause «يأخذهم».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The preposition «من شيء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; the clause «يتفيأ» is a naʿt (adjective) of «شيء». His words «سجَّدا»: a ḥāl of «الظلال»; the preposition «لله» is attached to «سجدا»; and the clause «وهم داخرون» is a ḥāl of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «سجَّدا».

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: «ما»: a relative noun, fāʿil (agent); the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause); the preposition «من دابة» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; «الملائكة» is a noun conjoined to «ما»; and the clause «وهم لا يستكبرون» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil of «يسجد».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «يخافون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of {لا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ}. The preposition «من فوقهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of «ربهم».

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: «اثنين»: a naʿt (adjective); the second object of اتخذ is omitted, i.e.: معبودا (an object of worship). The clause «إنما هو إله واحد» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. His words «فإياي فارهبون»: the fāʾ is a conjunction; a detached accusative pronoun is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied verb explained by what follows, its implied form being: ارهبوا; the yāʾ is for the first person; the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); and the yāʾ implied in the verb is the verb's object. The implied clause «فارهبوا» is conjoined to the clause «لا تتخذوا», and the clause «فارهبون» is explicative of the implied one.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: «واصبا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الدين». The clause «أفغير الله تتقون» is conjoined to the clause «له الدين». The fāʾ is a conjunction, and «غير» is a fronted object.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: His words «وما بكم من نعمة»: the wāw is resumptive; «ما» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause); the preposition «من نعمة» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); and the preposition «من الله» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of «ما». The conditional clause is conjoined to the resumptive one: «وما بكم من نعمة فمن الله». The clause «فإليه تجأرون» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position; the fronting of the prepositional phrase before the verb is what licensed the fāʾ. The clause «مسَّكم» is muḍāf ilayhi.

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the preceding conditional. «إذا»: a conditional adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the sense of the apodosis, its implied form being: أشرك بعضكم إذا كشف; the second «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya). The clause «إذا فريق يشركون» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). «فريق» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); beginning with an indefinite noun is licensed by its being qualified by «منكم». The preposition «بربهم» is attached to «يشركون».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليكفروا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the preceding {يُشْرِكُونَ}. The clause «فتمتعوا» is resumptive, and the clause «فسوف تعلمون» is conjoined to the clause «تمتعوا».

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The clause «ويجعلون» is resumptive. «لما»: the lām is a preposition; «ما» is a relative noun, [the phrase] attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «يجعلون»; «نصيبا» is the first object; the preposition «مما» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «نصيبا». The genitive [phrase of] the oath is attached to an implied أقسم. His words «لتسألن»: the lām occurs in the apodosis of the oath; an imperfect passive verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of like letters; the implied wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; and the nūn is for emphasis. The implied oath clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: The clause «ويجعلون» is conjoined to the earlier clause «يجعلون». His words «سبحانه»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the clause is parenthetical between the ḥāl (circumstantial) and the one it describes. The clause «لهم ما يشتهون» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «يجعلون». His words «ولهم ما يشتهون»: the wāw is circumstantial; the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the relative «ما», which is the mubtadaʾ (subject). It is not permissible to conjoin «لهم» to «لله», because the verb of a connected pronoun may not pass over to its own pronoun, either by itself or by a preposition, except in the chapter of ظن, as in ظننتُني (I thought myself); so one does not say: زيد غضب عليه, meaning: on himself.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the conditional clause in verse (54). The clause «بُشِّر» is muḍāf ilayhi, and «إذا» is a conditional adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the sense of the apodosis; it is not attached to «ظلَّ» because that is defective (nāqiṣa). The implied form is: بقي وجهه إذا بُشِّر. The clause «وهو كظيم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «وجهه».

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The clause «يتوارى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in {كَظِيمٌ}. The two prepositional phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; this is permitted even though they have the same wording, because their meanings differ: the first is for the beginning of the extent, and the second for causation. «ما»: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «أيمسكه» is resumptive; the preposition «على هون» is attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of يمسكه; «أم» is a conjunction; and the clause «ألا ساء ما يحكمون» is resumptive. «ما» is a relative noun, fāʿil; the one specified for blame is omitted, its implied form being: حكمهم (their judgement).

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The clause «للذين لا يؤمنون ... » is resumptive. «مثل» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the prepositional phrase before it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «وهو العزيز» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, and the clause «ما ترك» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). «دابة» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «ولكن يؤخرهم» is conjoined to the clause «يؤاخذ»; the clause «فإذا جاء أجلهم» is conjoined to the clause «يؤخرهم»; the clause «جاء» is muḍāf ilayhi; and «ساعة» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The preposition «لله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «يجعلون», and the relative noun is the first object. «الكذب» is the object of «تصف», and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن لهم الحسنى» is a badal (substitute) of «الكذب», whole for whole. His words «لا جرم»: «لا» is the lā of generic negation with its noun; the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being موجود (existing); and the interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition (في). The clause «وتصف» is conjoined to the clause «يجعلون», and the clause «لا جرم موجود» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: The oath expression «تالله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied أقسم; the preposition «من قبلك» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «أمم». The clause «فزين» is conjoined to the clause «أرسلنا»; the clause «فهو وليهم» is conjoined to the clause «زيَّن»; «اليوم» is an adverb attached to the khabar (predicate); and the clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «فهو وليهم».

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «لتبيِّن» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنزلنا». His words «وهدى»: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) of an implied governor, i.e.: وأنزلناه هدى. Since the agent is one and the same, the verb reached it by itself; but it is not one and the same in His words «وما أنزلنا إلا لتبين», for the agent of the sending down is Allah and the agent of the explaining is the Messenger, so the verb was connected with the lām. The clause «وأنزلناه هدى» is conjoined to the clause «ما أنزلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The clause «فأحيا» is conjoined to the clause «أنزل», and the lām in «لآية» is for emphasis.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: The clause «نسقيكم» is explicative of the lesson (ʿibra), with no grammatical position. The preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the preposition «في بطونه» is attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause). The pronoun in «في بطونه» refers back to «الأنعام» in the masculine singular form, because this word may be either a singular or a broken plural. The preposition «من بين» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «لبنا», and «خالصا سائغا» are two naʿts (adjectives).

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: His words «ومن ثمرات»: conjoined to the prepositional phrase {فِي الأَنْعَامِ}, and in meaning it is a khabar (predicate) about the noun of «إن» in His words: {وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِي الأَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً}; the implied form is: وإن لكم في الأنعام، ومن ثمرات النخيل لعبرة. The clause «تتخذون» is explicative of the lesson from the fruits of the date palms, with no grammatical position. The clause «يعقلون» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: «أن» is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause «اتخذي» is explicative.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: «ذللا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «سبل»; «مختلف» is a naʿt (adjective); «ألوانه» is the fāʿil (agent) of «مختلف». The clause «يخرج» is resumptive; the clause «فيه شفاء» is a second naʿt of «شراب»; and the clause «إن في ذلك لآية» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: The clause «ومنكم مَنْ يرد» is resumptive; «من» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «شيئا» is the object of «عِلْم»; and the object of «يعلم» is latent (mustatir), referring back to «شيئا» by way of contention (tanāzuʿ).

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The clause «فما الذين فضلوا» is conjoined to the clause «الله فضَّل». His words «برادّي»: the khabar (predicate) of «ما», which operates like ليس, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «فهم فيه سواء» is conjoined to the clause «ما الذين فُضِّلوا برادِّي». The preposition «فيه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «سواء». The clause «يجحدون» is resumptive, and the fāʾ is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: «بنين»: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. The clause «يؤمنون» is resumptive, and the clause «هم يكفرون» is conjoined to the clause «يؤمنون».

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «رزقا». The preposition «من السماوات» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «رزقا». His words «شيئا»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: little or much.

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The clause «فلا تضربوا» is resumptive, and so is the clause «إن الله يعلم». The clause «وأنتم لا تعلمون» is conjoined to the clause «إن الله يعلم», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: «عبدا»: a badal (substitute) of «مثلا», and the clause «لا يقدر» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «عبدا». His words «ومَن»: a relative noun conjoined to «عبدا». The clause «فهو ينفق» is conjoined to the clause «رزقناه»; «سرا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause «هل يستوون» is resumptive, and so are the two clauses «الحمد لله» and «أكثرهم لا يعلمون». He used the plural in His words «يستوون» even though two preceded it, because what is meant is the genus of slaves and free men.

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: «رجلين»: a badal (substitute) of «مثلا»; the clause «أحدهما أبكم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رجلين». The clause «لا يقدر» is a second khabar (predicate) of «أحدهما»; the clause «وهو كَلٌّ» is conjoined to the clause «لا يقدر»; and the conditional clause is a second khabar of «هو». His words «أينما»: a jussive conditional noun, an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يوجِّهه». The clause «هل يستوي» is resumptive. His words «هو»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in يستوي; «مَنْ» is a relative noun conjoined to the latent pronoun, the conjoining being licensed by the separation by the pronoun. The clause «وهو على صراط» is conjoined to the clause of the ṣila (relative clause).

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: The clause «وما أَمْرُ الساعة ... » is conjoined to the resumptive «ولله غيب». The preposition «كلمح» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the clause «أو هو أقرب» is conjoined to the implied khabar «كائن», as a case of conjoining a clause to a single word.

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: The clause «لا تعلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf in «أخرجكم». The clause «لعلكم تشكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: «مسخَّرات»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الطير»; the preposition «في جو» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مسخرات»; the clause «ما يمسكهن» is a second ḥāl of «الطير»; and the clause «يؤمنون» is a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: The preposition «من بيوتكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «سكنا»; the preposition «من جلود» is attached to a ḥāl of «بيوتا»; and the clause «تستخفونها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بيوتا». The preposition «من أصوافها» is conjoined to «من جلود» and is attached to what that is attached to, i.e.: وجعل لكم من أصوافها أثاثا; on this view a genitive has been conjoined to a genitive and an accusative to an accusative. The preposition «إلى حين» is attached to a naʿt of «متاعا».

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: The preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ظلالا». «ظلالا» is the object of «جعل»; «الحر» is a second object. The clause «تقيكم» is a naʿt (adjective). «كذلك»: the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi, i.e.: He completes His favour with a completing like that completing. The clause «لعلكم تسلمون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: The clause «فإن تولَّوا» is conjoined to the clause {يُتِمُّ}; «البلاغ» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The clause «يعرفون» is resumptive, and the clause «وأكثرهم الكافرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «ينكرونها».

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: His words «ويوم»: the wāw is resumptive; «يوم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «اذكر» (remember), and the implied clause is resumptive. The preposition «للذين» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause «ولا هم يستعتبون» is conjoined to the clause «يؤذن».

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: «إذا»: a conditional adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the sense of the apodosis. The clause «فلا يخفف» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: هو, referring back to «العذاب». The clause «فهو لا يخفف» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause «ولا هم ينظرون» is conjoined to the clause «فهو لا يخفف», in the position of the jussive. We implied the fāʾ as entering on «هو» because an imperfect verb joined with «لا» does not take the fāʾ of the apodosis.

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the preceding conditional clause. «الذين كنا»: the relative noun is a naʿt (adjective). The preposition «من دونك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied object of «ندعو», i.e.: ندعوهم كائنين من دونك (we call on them, being other than You). The clause «فألقوا» is resumptive; it is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a ḍamma implied on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. The clause «إنكم لكاذبون» is what is said (maqūl al-qawl) by the maṣdar (verbal noun) «القول», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: The clause «وألقوا» is conjoined to the preceding clause «ألقوا»; «يومئذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ألقوا»; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the tanwīn is in compensation for a clause. His words «ما يفترون»: a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent) of «ضلَّ».

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: «الذين كفروا» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «زدناهم» is the khabar (predicate). The adverb «فوق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عذابا». His words «بما»: «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to «زدناهم».

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: His words «ويوم نبعث»: the wāw is resumptive; «يوم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «اذكر»; «شهيدا» is a mafʿūl bihi, and the two prepositional phrases after it are attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; the second «شهيدا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf; «تبيانا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the preposition «لكل» is attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) «تبيانا»; and the preposition «للمسلمين» is attached to «بشرى».

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: The clause «يعظكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «ينهى», in the position of the accusative; the clause «لعلكم تذكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: «إذا»: a conditional adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the sense of the implied apodosis, i.e.: يلزم وفاؤكم إذا عاهدتم (your fulfilment is binding when you make a covenant). The clause «عاهدتم» is muḍāf ilayhi; the conditional clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «وقد جعلتم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «تنقضوا», and «كفيلا» is the second object of «جعل».

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: «أنكاثا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «غَزْلها»; «دخلا» is a second object; the clause «تتخذون» is a ḥāl of the pronoun of «يكونوا»; «بينكم» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «دخلا»; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: مخافةَ (for fear that). The clause «هي أربى» is the khabar (predicate) of كان. The clause «وليبيننَّ» is the apodosis of an implied oath, and the oath with its apodosis is a resumptive clause.

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, and the clause «ولكن يضل» is conjoined to the resumptive one. His words «ولتسألُن»: the wāw is a conjunction; an imperfect passive verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of like letters; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause «ولتسألن» is conjoined to the conditional clause, and it is composed of the oath and its apodosis.

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: «دخَلا»: a second object, and the adverb «بينكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «دخلا». His words «فَتَزِلَّ»: the fāʾ is causal; an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the fāʾ; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: لا يكن منكم اتخاذ أيمان فَزَلَل قدم (let there not be from you a taking of oaths and then a slipping of a foot). His words «بما صددتم»: the bāʾ is a preposition, «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive maṣdar is attached to «تذوقوا». The clause «ولكم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «تذوقوا», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: «إن» is abrogating; «ما» is a relative noun, its noun; the adverb «عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause); the clause «هو خير» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن». The clause «إن كنتم» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: «ما»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the adverb «عندكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause); and the clause «ينفد» is the khabar (predicate) of «ما». His words «باقٍ»: a nominative khabar of the relative «ما», nominative with a ḍamma implied on the dropped yāʾ. His words «أجرهم»: a second object. «ما كانوا»: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi.

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: «مَنْ»: a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition «من ذكر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «عمل», and the clause «وهو مؤمن» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil of «عمل». His words «فلنحيينَّه»: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), the lām occurs in the apodosis of the oath, and the clause is the apodosis of the oath; the oath with its apodosis is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being نحن. «حياة» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «إذا»: a conditional adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the sense of the apodosis, i.e.: تلزمك الاستعاذة إذا قرأت (seeking refuge is binding on you when you recite).

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: The clause «ليس له سلطان» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ»; the clause «يتوكلون» is conjoined to the clause آمنوا.

harrat-mujtaba:100-100.t: «إنما»: the restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa), and the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The preposition «به» is attached to the khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: «إذا»: a conditional adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis; «مكان» is an adverb of place attached to «بدَّلنا»; the clause «والله أعلم» is parenthetical; «مفترٍ» is a nominative khabar (predicate), with a ḍamma implied on the dropped yāʾ; and the clause «بل أكثرهم لا يعلمون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: The preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «نزله». His words «وهدى»: a noun conjoined to the preceding genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: للتثبيت وهدى (for making firm, and as guidance).

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أنهم يقولون» stands in place of the two objects of «علم»; the clause «لسان الذي يلحدون..» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: The clause «ولهم عذاب أليم» is conjoined to the clause «لا يهديهم الله».

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: «الذين»: a postponed fāʿil (agent). The clause «أولئك هم الكاذبون» is conjoined to the resumptive one, and «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: «مَنْ»: a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and its apodosis is implied, i.e.: فعليهم غضب; what comes after the second «من» indicates the apodosis. «إلا» is for exception; مَنْ is a relative noun, the excepted (mustathnā); and the clause «وقلبه مطمئن» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nāʾib [fāʿil] of «أُكْرِهَ» [Translator's note: the source says «فاعل» (agent) of the passive «أُكْرِهَ»]. The clause «ولكن من شرح» is conjoined to the resumptive «من كفر»; «صدرا» is a tamyīz (specification), and «شرح» is made to contain the sense of طاب (to be pleased). His words «فعليهم»: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), by likening the relative noun to the conditional, since «مَن» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, and the clause «فعليهم غضب» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «مَنْ». The clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «فعليهم غضب».

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «بأنهم استحبوا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the second maṣdar is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar.

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: His words «أولئك الذين»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); and «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: «لا جرم»: «لا» is the lā of generic negation with its noun; its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: موجود (existing); and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is accusative by removal of the preposition (في). «هم» is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and «الخاسرون» its khabar, and the clause is the khabar of «أن». The preposition «في الآخرة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «الخاسرون».

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: The clause «ثم إن ربك ... » is conjoined to the clause {لا جَرَمَ}. The preposition «للذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «إن», in the sense: He is their helper, not their forsaker. «ما» in His words «ما فتنوا» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi. The preposition «من بعدها» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ربك». The clause «إن ربك لغفور» is resumptive, emphasising the first clause.

harrat-mujtaba:111-111.t: «يوم»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «اذكر» (remember), and the clause «اذكر» is resumptive. The clause «تأتي» is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «تجادل» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «كل», the ḥāl from an indefinite being permitted because it is in construct. His words «ما عملت»: a noun, second object. The clause «وهم لا يظلمون» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «عملت», put in the plural according to the sense.

harrat-mujtaba:112-112.t: «قرية»: a badal (substitute); the clause «كانت» is a naʿt (adjective); «مطمئنة» is a second khabar (predicate); the clause «يأتيها رزقها» is a third khabar of «كان»; «رغدا» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «رزقها»; and «لباس» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:113-113.t: The clause «ولقد جاءهم رسول» is resumptive, and the clause «لقد جاءهم» is the apodosis of the oath. The clause «وهم ظالمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «أخذهم».

harrat-mujtaba:114-114.t: The clause «فكلوا» is resumptive; the preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; «حلالا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), originally an adjective of an omitted qualified noun, i.e.: طعاما حلالا (lawful food). «إياه» is a detached accusative pronoun, a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is for the third person. The conditional clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «تعبدون» is the khabar (predicate) of كان.

harrat-mujtaba:115-115.t: His words «وما أُهِل»: a relative noun conjoined to «لحم». His words «فمن اضطر»: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «مَن» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is the pronoun "he" (هو); «غير» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «اضطر»; «عادٍ» is conjoined to «باغ». The clause «فمن اضطر» is conjoined to the resumptive «إنما حرَّم», and the clause «اضطر» is the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:116-116.t: «لما»: the lām is a preposition and «ما» is maṣdariyya; the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and «الكذب» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «تصف». Its meaning is: do not declare things unlawful or lawful because of a statement your tongues utter without proof. The clause «هذا حلال» is what is said (maqūl al-qawl), and the interpreted maṣdar «لتفتروا» is a badal (substitute) of the preceding maṣdar.

harrat-mujtaba:117-117.t: «متاع»: the khabar (predicate) of an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: عيشهم (their living). The clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «عيشهم متاع».

harrat-mujtaba:118-118.t: The clause «حرَّمنا» is resumptive; the clause «وما ظلمناهم» is conjoined to the clause «حرَّمْنا»; and the clause «كانوا» is conjoined to «ظلمناهم».

harrat-mujtaba:119-119.t: The clause «ثم إن ربك» is conjoined to the earlier clause {حَرَّمْنَا}. The preposition «للذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the preposition «بجهالة» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «عملوا»; the preposition «من بعدها» is attached to a ḥāl of «ربك»; and the clause «إن ربك لغفور» is resumptive, emphasising the first.

harrat-mujtaba:120-120.t: «قانتا لله حنيفا»: two khabars (predicates) of كان, and the preposition «لله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قانتا». The clause «ولم يك» is conjoined to the clause «كان أمة». His words «لم يك»: an abrogating imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with a sukūn implied on the nūn, which was dropped for lightening; its noun is the pronoun "he" (هو).

harrat-mujtaba:121-121.t: «شاكرا»: a fourth khabar (predicate) of «كان», and the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شاكرا». The clause «اجتباه» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:122-122.t: The preposition «في الآخرة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «الصالحين»; the clause «وإنه لمن الصالحين» is conjoined to the clause «آتيناه», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:123-123.t: «أنْ» is explicative (mufassira), and the clause after it is explicative. «حنيفا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «إبراهيم»; the ḥāl from the muḍāf ilayhi is permitted because the muḍāf is like a part of the muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «وما كان» is conjoined to the ḥāl «حنيفا», as a case of conjoining a clause to a single word.

harrat-mujtaba:124-124.t: The two adverbs «بينهم» and «يوم» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the preposition «فيه» is attached to «يختلفون».

harrat-mujtaba:125-125.t: The clause «هو أعلم» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the preposition «بالمهتدين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعلم».

harrat-mujtaba:126-126.t: His words «ولئن»: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa), and «إن» is conditional. The lām in His words «لهو» occurs in the apodosis of the oath. The preposition «للصابرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير». The clause «ولئن صبرتم» is conjoined to the clause «إن عاقبتم»; the clause «لهو خير» is the apodosis of the oath, and the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the apodosis of the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:127-127.t: The clause «وما صبرك إلا بالله» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «اصبر»; the preposition «بالله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «صبرك»; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr). «تكُ» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with a sukūn implied on the nūn, which was dropped for lightening. His words «مما» are composed of the preposition «مِن» and the maṣdariyya «ما», and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to «ضيق».

harrat-mujtaba:128-128.t: «مع»: an adverb of place for accompaniment, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: The clause «فلا تستعجلوه» is conjoined to the clause «أتى أمر»; conjoining a performative (inshāʾ) clause to an informative (khabar) one is permitted. The clause «سبحانه» is resumptive; it is a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of an omitted governing verb, its implied form being «نسبح». The clause «وتعالى» is conjoined to the resumptive «سبحانه». «ما» in «عمَّا» is maṣdar-forming, and the maṣdar is genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تعالى».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «بالروح» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الملائكة», i.e. "accompanied", and the preposition and its genitive noun «من أمره» is attached to a ḥāl from «الروح». «أن» is explicative, and the clause after it is explicative. The clause of tanzīh (declaring Allah's oneness) «لا إله إلا أنا» is the khabar (predicate) of «أن»; «لا» is the lā of generic negation, «إله» is its noun, and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being «مستحق للعبادة»; «إلا» is for restriction, and «أنا» is a badal (substitute) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar. The interpreted maṣdar is the object of the warning. The clause «فاتقون» is conjoined to the clause of tanzīh; the yāʾ of the verb in «اتقون» was dropped for lightness, the kasra sufficing in its place.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «خلق», and «ما» in «عما» is maṣdar-forming.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «فإذا هو خصيم»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «إذا» is the «إذا» of surprise (fujāʾiyya), then a mubtadaʾ (subject), and its two khabars (predicates) are «خصيم مبين». The clause is conjoined to the resumptive clause «خلق».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «والأنعام»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «وخلق». The clause «وخلق الأنعام» is conjoined to the clause {خَلَقَ الإِنْسَانَ}, and the clause «خلقها» is explicative of the implied verb. The clause «لكم فيها دفء» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «خلقها»; the preposition and its genitive noun «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from «دفء». The clause «ومنها تأكلون» is conjoined to the clause «لكم فيها دفء».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «جمال»; «جمال» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «تريحون» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «وتحمل» is conjoined to the clause {وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ}, and the clause «لم تكونوا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بلد». The preposition and its genitive noun «بشق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «بالغيه», i.e. "you would not reach it except while beset with hardship".

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: «والخيل»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «الأنعام» in verse (5). «لتركبوها»: accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن», and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied verb «خلق». «وزينة»: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The verb reaches the first by means of the lām in «لتركبوها» and reaches «زينة» by itself only because a condition is lacking in the first, namely the non-identity of the agent: the Creator is Allah while the riders are those addressed, unlike the second. The clause «ويخلق» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «ومنها جائر» is parenthetical, and the clause «ولو شاء لهداكم» is conjoined to the resumptive «وعلى الله قصد». «أجمعين» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the kāf.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «لكم منه شراب» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ماء», and the clause «ومنه شجر» is conjoined to the clause «لكم منه شراب»; the clause «تسيمون» is a naʿt of «شجر». The preposition and its genitive noun «منه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «شراب»; the clause «تسيمون» is a naʿt of «شجر»; the preposition and its genitive noun «فيه» is attached to «تسيمون».

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «ومن كل»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. "and something of every…". The clause «يتفكرون» is a naʿt of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «والنجوم مُسَخَّرات» is conjoined to the clause «سخَّر», with no grammatical position. The preposition and its genitive noun «بأمره» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مسخرات», and the clause «يعقلون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: «وما ذرأ»: a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «القمر», and the two prepositional phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ذرأ». «مختلفًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما», and «ألوانه» is the fāʿil (agent) of «مختلفا».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «وهو الذي» is conjoined to the clause {هُوَ الَّذِي} in verse (10). The clause «تَلْبَسُونَهَا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «حِلْيَةً», and the clause «وترى» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements. The maṣdar «ولتبتغوا» is conjoined to the clause «لتأكلوا», and the clause «ولعلكم تشكرون» is conjoined to the single word, the "seeking".

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The maṣdar «أن تميد» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "out of aversion that…". The clause «لعلكم تهتدون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «وعلامات» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «سبلا», and the clause «هم يهتدون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «أفمن يخلق» is resumptive; «مَنْ» is a relative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition and its genitive noun «كمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «أفلا تذكَّرون» is conjoined to the resumptive «أفمن يخلق».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «وإن تعدوا» is resumptive; «رحيم» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «والذين يدعون» is resumptive. The preposition and its genitive noun «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied pronoun referring to the relative. The clause «لا يخلقون» is the khabar (predicate), and the clause «وهم يُخْلَقون» is a ḥāl from the wāw in «يَخْلقون».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «أموات» is a second khabar (predicate) of «هم», and «غير» a third khabar. «أيَّان» is an interrogative noun, an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يبعثون». The clause «يبعثون» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «يشعرون», whose operation is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative, it having taken on the meaning of a transitive verb of the heart. The clause «وما يشعرون» is conjoined to the clause {يَخْلُقُونَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «واحد» is a naʿt (adjective). The clause «فالذين لا يؤمنون» is resumptive; «قلوبهم» is a second mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «قلوبهم منكرة» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين». The clause «وهم مستكبرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «قلوبهم».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: «لا جرم»: «لا» is the lā of generic negation, «جرم» is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being «موجود». The interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition (في).

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: (وإذا قيل لهم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «قيل» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is the pronoun of the maṣdar. «ماذا»: «ما» is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «ذا» is a relative noun, the khabar (predicate). «أساطير» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being «هي», and the clause «هي أساطير» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The interpreted maṣdar «ليحملوا» is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) {قَالُوا}. «كاملة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أوزارهم», and «يوم» is an adverb attached to «يحملوا». «ومن أوزار»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted qualified noun conjoined to «أوزارهم», the implied form being: "and burdens being of the burdens". The preposition and its genitive noun «بغير» is attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «يضلون». «ألا»: a particle of opening (istiftāḥ) and drawing attention; «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil of «ساء», and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "their load"; the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The clause «قد مكر» is resumptive, and the clause «فأتى» is conjoined to the resumptive one. The preposition and its genitive noun «من القواعد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أتى»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من فوقهم» is attached to «خرَّ». The clause «لا يشعرون» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The adverb «يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يخزيهم». «أين»: an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, an adverb of place attached to the khabar (predicate); «شركائي» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective). «اليوم» is an adverb attached to the notion of "being settled" (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of {الْكَافِرِينَ}; «ظالمي» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «تتوفَّاهم». The clause «فألقوا السلم» is conjoined to the clause «تتوفاهم», and the clause «ما كنا» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied saying, the saying being accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. "they offered submission, saying". «من سوء»: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «إن الله عليم» is the content of an implied saying, in the position of an accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «فادخلوا» is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). «خالدين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خالدين». «فلبئس»: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the lām in «لبئس» falls in the answer to an omitted oath, the implied form being: "so by Allah, how evil is the abode". The clause «فوالله لبئس مثوى» is resumptive, and the clause «لبئس مثوى» is the answer to the oath; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. «جهنم».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «وقيل» is resumptive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is the pronoun of the maṣdar of «قيل». «ماذا»: «ما» is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the relative «ذا» is the khabar (predicate). «خيرا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «أنزل», and the clause «أنزل خيرا» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). The preposition and its genitive noun «للذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar, and the preposition and its genitive noun «في هذه» is attached to «أحسنوا». The clause «ولدار الآخرة خير» is resumptive. The lām in «لنعم» falls in the answer to an omitted oath, the implied form being: "and by Allah, how excellent is the abode"; the clause «ووالله لنعم دار» is resumptive, and the clause «لنعم دار» is the answer to the oath; the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, i.e. «دار الآخرة».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «جنات»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they are gardens", and the clause «هي جنات» is explicative of the preceding praise. The clause «يدخلونها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «جنات», and the clause «تجري» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the third-person pronoun in «يدخلونها»; the clause «لهم فيها ما يشاءون» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «يدخلونها». «كذلك»: the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "Allah recompenses with a recompense like that recompense"; the clause «يجزي» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «المتقين», and «طيبين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ. «سلام» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); beginning with an indefinite is permitted because it is a supplication. The clause «يقولون» is a ḥāl from «الملائكة», and the clause «ادخلوا» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The clause «هل ينظرون» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar is the object of «ينظرون». «كذلك»: the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the implied form being: "those before them did a doing like that doing". The clause «فعل» is resumptive, and the clause «وما ظلمهم الله» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements, because the following clause {فَأَصَابَهُمْ} is conjoined to the clause «فعل». The clause «ولكن كانوا» is conjoined to the clause «ما ظلمهم الله». «أنفسهم»: a fronted object of the verb «يظلمون», and the clause «يظلمون» is the khabar (predicate) of «كان».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: «ما عملوا»: «ما» is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «ما كانوا»: a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent) of «حاق».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The clause «وقال الذين» is resumptive. The preposition and its genitive noun «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «شيء»; «شيء» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). «نحن» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the nominative pronoun in «عبدنا»; «لا» is redundant, to emphasize the negation; «آباؤنا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the pronoun «نا»; conjoining an overt noun to an attached nominative pronoun is permitted because of the separating element between them. «ولا حَرَّمنا من دونه من شيء» is like what precedes it. The clause «فعل» is resumptive. «فهل على الرسل»: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to the khabar (predicate) of «البلاغ», which is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «إلا» is for restriction, and the clause is resumptive.
